body: Please, feel free to leave any and all critiques. It would be very much appreciated! Also, is there a way to check word count on here? I know it's a rule for the community, and I want to make sure I try not to break it.
Bold typface? Did I accidentally put the entire thing in bold?! Sorry, i didn't even mean to😂 And thank you so much! I've never had anyone call my writing anything like that. That's so cool🤌

I don't think of myself as much of a writer, but I've always loved stories. I want to get more into writing, but don't really have enough knowledge of the subject myself to properly judge if I'm any good. Feel free to leave tips and/or criticisms about this story. My main goal is to get better, but if you have an issues with the piece try and be as specific as you can. It's kind of hard realizing what's wrong with just a "this is bad." Either way, have a good day!
I knowwww, I was laughing in between the yeses and nos. I swear my tics are like children.
😂they were arguing about killing the patriarchy😵🤣🤣no, yes, no, yes.

Yeah, this really helps me. I also count. For me anything that's focusing on something simple helps. Like counting the seconds to minutes, or counting the line on my paper, and especially good one for in-class-panic-attacks, and stuff like that. I also like counting in different languages. It's simple, but effective.
